claim.text: A winning ticket discovered on CIFAR-10a (a subset of the CIFAR-10 dataset containing 25,000 training images with 2,500 images per class), transfers to a disjoint subset CIFAR-10b from the same data distribution and improves training on that held-out subset relative to random sparse initializations.
The within-distribution transfer described in claim 12 holds for both VGG19 and ResNet50.
ResNet50 showed sensitivity at low pruning fractions, occasionally under-performing random tickets when few weights are pruned.
